title: Moody's Corporation (MCO) stock price, news, quote and history - Yahoo Finance Australia
Moody’s lifts Victoria’s Secret outlook to positive on stronger credit metrics
summary: Investing.com -- Moody’s Ratings revised its outlook on Victoria's Secret & Co (NYSE:VSXY) to positive from stable on Friday, signaling growing confidence in the retailer’s operational turnaround and strengthening credit profile. While affirming the company’s Ba3 corporate family rating alongside its senior secured and unsecured debt ratings, the agency also upgraded Victoria’s Secret’s speculative-grade liquidity rating to SGL-1 from SGL-2.
